messages.subject: Artificial DATA
parts:
Hi all,

Within Bock and Aitkin (EM) method, the so-called artificial data, specifically - f_{iq} : expected number of subjects answering item "i" with quadrature value "q" for the latent trait and r_{iq} : expected number of subjects correctly answering item "i" with quadrature value "q" for the latent trait, need to be calculated.

Is there any way to get such information from mirt/multipleGroup functions?

Best,

Caio

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Artificial DATA
parts:
It's undocumented, but yes you can. Use an input technical = list(storeEtable=TRUE), and extract this table from the @Internal$Etable location. 

Phil
